statement: For X=X(r), partial_i partial_j X = X_second n_i n_j + (X_prime/r)(delta_ij-n_i n_j), so the STF Hessian amplitude is X_second-X_prime/r.
The no-Hessian-STF equation X_second-X_prime/r=0 integrates to X_prime=C*r and X=X0+C*r^2/2.
Even when the Hessian STF vanishes, P_TF[partial_iX partial_jX]=X_prime^2(n_i n_j-delta_ij/3)=C^2*r^2(n_i n_j-delta_ij/3), so the gradient-square piece vanishes only if C=0.
If the local branch forbids the growing r^2 extra-field mode, then C=0, X=X0, and both Hessian-STF and gradient-square-STF terms vanish.
